purpose: Formal schema for the multimodal urban flood susceptibility feature matrix. This schema describes attributes per patch associated with flood susceptibility. It does NOT constitute ground truth and does NOT unlock supervised training.

groups.land_use: Land use and land cover proxies
groups.proxy_v5: Binary proxy indicators used in score v5 computation
groups.heuristic_label: Heuristic labels derived from scores (not GT)
groups.qa: Quality assurance, ranking, and selection metadata

features.name: patch_id
features.interpretation: Unique patch identifier: region_NNNNN format.
features.notes: Primary key. Not a feature itself.

features.name: regiao
features.interpretation: Study region: curitiba, petropolis, or recife.
features.notes: Stratification variable, not a predictor.

features.name: reference_date
features.interpretation: Reference date for the patch observation window.
features.notes: Temporal anchor. All patches use 2022-12-31.

features.name: xmin
features.interpretation: Western boundary of the patch bounding box.
features.notes: Geometry, not a susceptibility feature.

features.name: ymin
features.interpretation: Southern boundary of the patch bounding box.
features.notes: Geometry, not a susceptibility feature.

features.name: xmax
features.interpretation: Eastern boundary of the patch bounding box.
features.notes: Geometry, not a susceptibility feature.

features.name: ymax
features.interpretation: Northern boundary of the patch bounding box.
features.notes: Geometry, not a susceptibility feature.

features.name: B2_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-2 Band 2 (Blue, 490nm) reflectance over patch.
features.notes: Raw band statistic. Useful as input to indices or direct feature.

features.name: B3_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-2 Band 3 (Green, 560nm) reflectance over patch.
features.notes: Used in NDWI and MNDWI computation.

features.name: B4_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-2 Band 4 (Red, 665nm) reflectance over patch.
features.notes: Used in NDVI computation.

features.name: B8_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-2 Band 8 (NIR, 842nm) reflectance over patch.
features.notes: Used in NDVI, NDWI, NDBI computation.

features.name: B11_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-2 Band 11 (SWIR1, 1610nm) reflectance over patch.
features.notes: Used in MNDWI and NDBI computation.

features.name: B12_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-2 Band 12 (SWIR2, 2190nm) reflectance over patch.
features.notes: Complementary SWIR band.

features.name: ndvi_mean
features.interpretation: Mean NDVI: (NIR-RED)/(NIR+RED). Higher values indicate more vegetation cover, which typically reduces flood susceptibility through soil permeability.
features.notes: Formula confirmed in PROJETO/src/revp/features_optical.py ndvi_spec().

features.name: mndwi_mean
features.interpretation: Mean MNDWI: (GREEN-SWIR)/(GREEN+SWIR). Higher values indicate water/wet surfaces, which increases flood susceptibility evidence.
features.notes: Formula confirmed in PROJETO/src/revp/features_optical.py mndwi_spec().

features.name: ndbi_mean
features.interpretation: Mean NDBI: (SWIR-NIR)/(SWIR+NIR). Higher values indicate built-up/impervious surfaces, which increases flood susceptibility through reduced infiltration.
features.notes: Formula confirmed in PROJETO/src/revp/features_optical.py ndbi_spec().

features.name: elevation_mean
features.interpretation: Mean elevation over patch. Lower elevations are typically more susceptible to flooding.
features.notes: Source likely GEE DEM or local PE3D/SGB MDE. Provenance script must be audited.

features.name: elevation_std
features.interpretation: Standard deviation of elevation within patch. Low std on low elevation indicates flat lowland prone to accumulation.
features.notes: Same provenance concern as elevation_mean.

features.name: slope_mean
features.interpretation: Mean terrain slope. Flat terrain (low slope) tends to accumulate water; steep terrain drains faster but may generate flash floods.
features.notes: Derived from DEM. Spec confirmed in PROJETO/src/revp/features_topo_hydro.py.

features.name: slope_std
features.interpretation: Standard deviation of slope within patch. Indicates terrain heterogeneity.
features.notes: Same provenance as slope_mean.

features.name: hand_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Height Above Nearest Drainage. Lower HAND values indicate physical proximity to drainage level, strongly increasing flood susceptibility.
features.notes: Critical hydrological feature. Source likely GEE HAND dataset or derived from DEM+drainage. Provenance audit required.

features.name: twi_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Topographic Wetness Index: ln(a/tan(b)). Higher TWI indicates greater tendency to accumulate water.
features.notes: Derived from DEM slope and contributing area. Source script must be audited.

features.name: tpi_250m_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Topographic Position Index at 250m window. Negative values indicate valleys/depressions prone to water accumulation.
features.notes: Derived from DEM. Window size 250m documented.

features.name: curvature_laplacian_mean
features.interpretation: Mean Laplacian curvature. Negative values indicate concave terrain (convergence of flow).
features.notes: Derived from DEM second derivatives.

features.name: distance_to_water_mean
features.interpretation: Mean distance from patch pixels to nearest water body/drainage. Shorter distances increase flood susceptibility.
features.notes: REV-P/scripts/dino/revp_v1gq uses GeoJSON hydrography layers for distance computation.

features.name: water_occurrence_patch
features.interpretation: Fraction of patch area with historical water occurrence (JRC Global Surface Water). Higher values indicate recurrent water presence.
features.notes: Source likely JRC/Google Global Surface Water dataset via GEE.

features.name: flow_acc_log_mean
features.interpretation: Mean log-transformed flow accumulation. Higher values indicate convergence of surface runoff.
features.notes: Derived from DEM flow routing. Provenance script must be audited.

features.name: flow_acc_log_p75
features.interpretation: 75th percentile of log flow accumulation within patch.
features.notes: Same provenance as flow_acc_log_mean.

features.name: runoff_context_7d
features.interpretation: 7-day runoff context combining rainfall and terrain. Higher values indicate greater runoff potential.
features.notes: Composite metric. Provenance script must be audited.

features.name: runoff_context_30d
features.interpretation: 30-day runoff context. Higher values indicate sustained wet conditions amplifying flood risk.
features.notes: Same provenance concern as runoff_context_7d.

features.name: chirps_3d_mm
features.interpretation: CHIRPS 3-day accumulated precipitation. Higher values indicate recent intense rainfall.
features.notes: Source: CHIRPS via GEE. Temporal window relative to reference_date.

features.name: chirps_7d_mm
features.interpretation: CHIRPS 7-day accumulated precipitation.
features.notes: Same source as chirps_3d_mm.

features.name: chirps_30d_mm
features.interpretation: CHIRPS 30-day accumulated precipitation. Indicates antecedent moisture conditions.
features.notes: Same source as chirps_3d_mm.

features.name: rain_3d_7d_ratio
features.interpretation: Ratio of 3-day to 7-day rainfall. High ratio indicates concentrated recent rainfall.
features.notes: Derived from chirps columns. Computation is straightforward division.

features.name: rain_7d_30d_ratio
features.interpretation: Ratio of 7-day to 30-day rainfall. Indicates recent vs antecedent rainfall balance.
features.notes: Derived from chirps columns.

features.name: rain_persistence_index
features.interpretation: Index of rainfall persistence over time. Higher values indicate sustained wet conditions.
features.notes: Composite metric. Formula must be audited.

features.name: s1_vv_mean_clean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-1 VV polarization backscatter (cleaned). Lower values may indicate smoother/wetter surfaces.
features.notes: Cleaned SAR. Cleaning method and temporal matching must be audited.

features.name: s1_vh_mean_clean
features.interpretation: Mean Sentinel-1 VH polarization backscatter (cleaned).
features.notes: Same provenance concern as s1_vv_mean_clean.

features.name: s1_vv_minus_vh_mean_clean
features.interpretation: VV minus VH polarization difference. Sensitive to surface roughness and moisture.
features.notes: Derived from s1_vv and s1_vh.

features.name: urban_prop
features.interpretation: Fraction of patch classified as urban/built-up. Higher values indicate more impervious surface, increasing flood susceptibility.
features.notes: Source uncertain: possibly MapBiomas-derived or GEE classification. Provenance audit critical.

features.name: vegetation_prop
features.interpretation: Fraction of patch with vegetation cover. Higher values indicate more permeable surface, reducing flood susceptibility.
features.notes: Same provenance concern as urban_prop.

features.name: urban_water_interaction
features.interpretation: Interaction term: urban proportion combined with water proximity/occurrence. Higher values indicate urban areas near water.
features.notes: Composite interaction. Formula must be audited.

features.name: urban_drainage_interaction
features.interpretation: Interaction term: urban proportion combined with drainage proximity. Higher values indicate impervious areas near drainage.
features.notes: Composite interaction. Formula must be audited.

features.name: proxy_v5_hand_low
features.interpretation: Binary flag: HAND below threshold indicating physical flood predisposition.
features.notes: Threshold and derivation from score v5 system. Not GT.

features.name: proxy_v5_distance_water_low
features.interpretation: Binary flag: distance to water below threshold.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_flow_accumulation
features.interpretation: Binary flag: high flow accumulation.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_twi_wetness
features.interpretation: Binary flag: high TWI indicating wet terrain.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_flat_terrain
features.interpretation: Binary flag: flat terrain prone to water accumulation.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_low_elevation
features.interpretation: Binary flag: low absolute elevation.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_water_history
features.interpretation: Binary flag: historical water occurrence above threshold.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_rainfall_context
features.interpretation: Binary flag: significant rainfall context.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_runoff_context
features.interpretation: Binary flag: significant runoff context.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_rain_concentration
features.interpretation: Binary flag: rainfall concentrated in recent days.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_rain_persistence
features.interpretation: Binary flag: persistent rainfall over time.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_urban_exposure
features.interpretation: Binary flag: high urban exposure.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_vegetation_low
features.interpretation: Binary flag: low vegetation cover.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_urban_water_interaction
features.interpretation: Binary flag: urban area near water.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_urban_drainage_interaction
features.interpretation: Binary flag: urban area near drainage.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_ndbi_built
features.interpretation: Binary flag: high NDBI indicating built-up area.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_ndvi_low
features.interpretation: Binary flag: low NDVI indicating lack of vegetation.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: proxy_v5_mndwi_wet
features.interpretation: Binary flag: high MNDWI indicating wet surface.
features.notes: Part of score v5 proxy system.

features.name: score_predisposicao_hidrotopografica_v5
features.interpretation: Composite hydrotopographic predisposition score. Combines elevation, slope, HAND, TWI, TPI, curvature, distance to water, flow accumulation.
features.notes: Heuristic composite. Not a feature (it is derived from features). Not GT.

features.name: score_gatilho_hidroclimatico_v5
features.interpretation: Hydroclimatic trigger score. Combines rainfall intensity, persistence, and runoff context.
features.notes: Heuristic composite. Not GT.

features.name: score_amplificacao_urbana_v5
features.interpretation: Urban amplification score. Combines urban proportion, impermeabilization proxies, and interaction terms.
features.notes: Heuristic composite. Not GT.

features.name: score_superficie_optica_v5_diagnostic
features.interpretation: Optical surface diagnostic score. Combines NDVI, MNDWI, NDBI indicators.
features.notes: Heuristic composite. Diagnostic only.

features.name: score_umidade_antecedente_v5
features.interpretation: Antecedent moisture score.
features.notes: Heuristic composite. Not GT.

features.name: score_impulso_chuva_v5
features.interpretation: Rainfall impulse score.
features.notes: Heuristic composite. Not GT.

features.name: score_evento_enchente_potencial_v5_core
features.interpretation: Core potential flood event score combining all sub-scores.
features.notes: Top-level heuristic. NOT ground truth. NOT validated against observed events.

features.name: label_evento_enchente_potencial_v5_core_regional_p75
features.interpretation: Heuristic binary label: 1 if score_evento_enchente_potencial_v5_core exceeds regional 75th percentile. THIS IS NOT GROUND TRUTH.
features.notes: CRITICAL: This is a heuristic label derived from composite scores, NOT from observed flood events. Must NEVER be treated as ground truth for supervised training.

features.name: label_confidence_v5
features.interpretation: Confidence level of the heuristic label.
features.notes: Describes confidence in the heuristic, not in reality.

features.name: study_value_score_v1
features.interpretation: Study value score indicating scientific utility of the patch.
features.notes: QA metric for patch selection, not a susceptibility feature.

features.name: regime_evento_enchente_v5
features.interpretation: Categorical regime classification of flood event potential.
features.notes: Heuristic classification. Not GT.
